strings.text: The Chrysalids

You are David Strorm, son of the strictest man in Waknuk. Here one toe too many is reason enough to cast a child out into the Fringes. You and your friends differ in a way no one can see: you speak to each other in thoughts. So far, no one knows.
strings.translation: Eres David Strorm, hijo del hombre más severo de Waknuk. Aquí un dedo de más en el pie basta para expulsar a un niño a las Tierras Marginales. Tú y tus amigos sois distintos de un modo que nadie puede ver: habláis entre vosotros con el pensamiento. Por ahora, nadie lo sabe.

strings.text: In a community where any difference is a sin, a boy hides his gift: he hears his friends’ thoughts.
strings.translation: En una comunidad donde cualquier diferencia es pecado, un muchacho esconde su don: oye los pensamientos de sus amigos.

strings.text: after the novel by John Wyndham
strings.translation: según la novela de John Wyndham

“Whose are you?”

covered it in time
too late

strings.translation: La mirada de la señora Wender

I was ten. The sandy bank by the stream was all mine.
strings.translation: Tenía diez años. La ladera de arena junto al arroyo era solo mía.

strings.text: Until a girl got up out of the grass at the top.
strings.translation: Hasta que arriba, entre la hierba, se levantó una niña.

strings.text: Does it hurt?
Whose are you?
Sit beside her
Does it hurt?
It hurts. Only don’t look at it.
Whose are you? I haven’t seen you before.
strings.translation: —¿De quién eres? No te había visto nunca.

strings.text: The Wenders’. We live over the hill.
strings.translation: —De los Wender. Vivimos al otro lado de la colina.

strings.text: Untie it. Only carefully.
I sat down beside her and said nothing. She cried a little more, and was quiet.
strings.translation: Me senté a su lado y no dije nada. Lloró un poco más y se calmó.

strings.text: There were six toes on her foot.
strings.translation: Tenía seis dedos en el pie.

strings.text: Every Sunday my father read us the Definitions: “And each foot shall have five toes.”
strings.translation: Cada domingo mi padre nos leía las Definiciones: «Y cada pie tendrá cinco dedos».

strings.text: Hooves. Her foot must not be seen.
strings.translation: Cascos. Nadie debía verle el pie.

strings.text: The rider went by and did not turn his head.
strings.translation: El jinete pasó de largo sin volver la cabeza.

strings.text: The rider reined in his horse. He looked at us from the meadow — a long time.
strings.translation: El jinete frenó el caballo. Nos miró desde el prado, largo rato.

strings.text: Then he rode on.
Promise you won’t tell anyone.
strings.translation: —Prométeme que no se lo dirás a nadie.

strings.text: I promise
I promise.
Mummy!
Finger to lips
Look away
She nodded to me. As to a grown-up.
strings.translation: Me hizo un gesto con la cabeza. Como a un adulto.

strings.text: Mrs Wender will remember this.
I looked at the sand. When I raised my eyes, she was already going — quickly, without looking back.
strings.translation: Me quedé mirando la arena. Cuando alcé los ojos, ella ya se iba, deprisa, sin mirar atrás.

strings.text: Her name was Sophie. From that day on we met nearly every day.
strings.translation: Se llamaba Sophie. Desde aquel día nos vimos casi a diario.

strings.text: All summer we ran off to the ruins of the Old People — where we were not allowed to go.
strings.translation: Todo el verano nos escapábamos a las ruinas de los Antiguos, adonde no nos dejaban ir.

strings.text: Something glinted in the grass. I began to scrape the earth away with my hands.
strings.translation: Algo brilló entre la hierba. Empecé a apartar la tierra con las manos.

strings.text: A smooth plate with the Old People’s letters on it. What had it been for?
strings.translation: Una placa lisa con letras de los Antiguos. ¿Para qué la usarían?

strings.text: Showing the way
For prayers
A toy
To show the way.
They prayed to it.
It’s just a toy.
Perhaps. Only the roads from here had led nowhere for a long time.
strings.translation: Tal vez. Solo que los caminos de aquí hacía mucho que no llevaban a ninguna parte.

strings.text: Hush. If they hear, we’ll be in trouble.
strings.translation: —Calla. Si nos oyen, nos la vamos a cargar.

strings.text: Some toys they had!
Take it home
Leave it
I pushed it inside my shirt.
strings.translation: Me la metí bajo la camisa.

strings.text: Let it lie. The Old People knew so much — and lost it all the same.
strings.translation: Que se quede ahí. Los Antiguos sabían tanto… y aun así lo perdieron todo.

strings.text: From far off, from Waknuk, came the sound of the bell. Time to go home.
strings.translation: De lejos, desde Waknuk, llegó el sonido de la campana. Hora de volver a casa.

strings.text: I never did dig it out all the way.
strings.translation: Nunca llegué a desenterrarla del todo.

strings.text: Grab it, run
Pull it, run
Drop it, run
Run home
At home it smelt of bread and wax.
strings.translation: En casa olía a pan y a cera.

strings.text: Where have you been all day, David?
strings.translation: —¿Dónde has estado todo el día, David?

strings.text: By the stream
About the girl
By the stream. On my own.
I met a girl. She has six toes on her foot.
strings.translation: —He conocido a una niña. Tiene seis dedos en el pie.

strings.text: Sophie will remember this.
Your father was asking. Don’t be late for prayers.
strings.translation: —Tu padre ha preguntado por ti. No llegues tarde a la oración.

strings.text: No one. Do you hear? Not your father, not the inspector. No one.
strings.translation: —A nadie. ¿Me oyes? Ni a tu padre, ni al inspector. A nadie.

strings.text: Sophie will not know of it. Not yet.
strings.translation: Sophie no lo sabrá. Todavía no.

strings.text: That night I hid the Old People’s plate under a floorboard.
strings.translation: Esa noche escondí la placa de los Antiguos bajo una tabla del suelo.

strings.text: As it should be
The evening chores
as it should be
lost the order
The cut hand
hold my hand out to my mother
strings.translation: tenderle la mano a mi madre

strings.text: “I can do it”
“If I had another hand”
say it again to my father
“Nothing, Father”
On my knees
look for my mother
strings.translation: buscar a mi madre con la mirada

strings.text: look at the floor
The calf
tell my father
lead it behind the barn
On our knees with everyone
go down on my knees
be late
The hymn by the fire
sing at the top of my voice
move my lips
keep silent
The stalk on the ashes
stay by the stalk
go with my mother
The night before the raid
strings.translation: La noche antes de la redada

strings.text: warn Sophie
stay at home
With my father everything was done as it should be. In the evening — water from the well, then the barn, then prayers.
strings.translation: Con mi padre todo se hacía como debe ser. Por la tarde, agua del pozo, luego el granero, luego la oración.

strings.text: Not now. First — water from the well.
strings.translation: Ahora no. Primero, agua del pozo.

strings.text: Not now. First — the barn.
Now — prayers.
Draw water
Shut the barn
Go to prayers
My father saw it all. He said nothing — and that was the worst of it.
strings.translation: Mi padre lo vio todo. No dijo nada, y eso fue lo peor.

strings.text: That evening I cut my hand open on the harrow.
strings.translation: Esa tarde me abrí la mano con la grada.

strings.text: When my father was reading, one came into the house on tiptoe.
strings.translation: Cuando mi padre leía, se entraba en casa de puntillas.

strings.text: Offer my hand
I’ll do it
I can do it.
Give it here.
That’s no way to tie it.
If I’d had another hand, I could have managed it myself.
strings.translation: —Si tuviera otra mano, podría haberlo hecho yo solo.

strings.text: What did you say?
Say it again
Nothing, Father
I said… if I had another hand…
strings.translation: —He dicho… que si tuviera otra mano…

strings.text: This is the Image of God. One head. Two hands.
strings.translation: —Esta es la Imagen de Dios. Una cabeza. Dos manos.

strings.text: Lord, forgive him his word. Let him never wish for another image.
strings.translation: —Señor, perdónale su palabra. Que nunca desee otra imagen.

strings.text: Raise my eyes
Look down
I looked at the floor. Only much later did I learn that she had looked at me then.
strings.translation: Miré al suelo. Solo mucho después supe que ella me había mirado entonces.

strings.text: Go upstairs.
No one cleared away my bowl that evening.
strings.translation: Esa noche nadie recogió mi cuenco.

strings.text: Nothing, Father.
Emily. What did he say?
That his hand hurts, Joseph. That is all.
strings.translation: —Que le duele la mano, Joseph. Nada más.

strings.text: Mother will remember this.
My mother had never lied to my father before.
strings.translation: Mi madre nunca antes le había mentido a mi padre.

strings.text: Every autumn the inspector came and decided what should live.
strings.translation: Cada otoño venía el inspector y decidía qué debía vivir.

strings.text: I watched our calf from behind the barn — until the inspector looked at it.
strings.translation: Yo miraba nuestro ternero desde detrás del granero, hasta que el inspector se fijó en él.

strings.text: Tell my father
Its legs were a little too long. Only a little.
strings.translation: Tenía las patas un poco demasiado largas. Solo un poco.

strings.text: The inspector reached the calf before I did. Its legs were a little too long. Only a little.
strings.translation: El inspector llegó al ternero antes que yo. Tenía las patas un poco demasiado largas. Solo un poco.

strings.text: Lead it away
Father, the calf’s legs aren’t right.
strings.translation: —Padre, el ternero tiene las patas raras.

strings.text: While the inspector leafed through his book, I led the calf away behind the barn.
strings.translation: Mientras el inspector hojeaba su libro, me llevé el ternero detrás del granero.

strings.text: The inspector found nothing. But the farmhand saw where I had taken it.
strings.translation: El inspector no encontró nada. Pero el mozo vio adónde lo había llevado.

strings.text: The farmhand will remember this.
I told. My father turned slowly towards me.
strings.translation: Lo dije. Mi padre se volvió despacio hacia mí.

strings.text: I kept quiet. The inspector saw it for himself.
strings.translation: Me callé. El inspector lo vio por sí mismo.

strings.text: You keep your eyes open. That is good, David.
strings.translation: —Tienes los ojos bien abiertos. Eso está bien, David.

strings.text: Father will remember this.
They took the calf away. My father did not look my way.
strings.translation: Se llevaron el ternero. Mi padre no miró hacia mí.

strings.text: They burned the deviant wheat till dawn, the whole community together. What was in doubt, the inspector decided.
strings.translation: Quemaron el trigo desviado hasta el amanecer, toda la comunidad junta. Lo dudoso lo decidía el inspector.

strings.text: An Offence.
Kneel
Everyone was on their knees already. Everyone but me.
strings.translation: Todos estaban ya de rodillas. Todos menos yo.

strings.text: The wheat caught at once, crackling like straw.
strings.translation: El trigo prendió enseguida, crepitando como paja.

strings.text: Everyone sang. You had to sing with everyone — in time.
strings.translation: Todos cantaban. Había que cantar con todos, a compás.

strings.text: David… Will they do that to us too? Into the fire?
strings.translation: David… ¿A nosotros también nos harán eso? ¿Al fuego?

strings.text: Don’t sing with them. Please.
strings.translation: No cantes con ellos. Por favor.

strings.text: I sang loudly, louder than my mother. The voice was not mine.
strings.translation: Canté fuerte, más fuerte que mi madre. La voz no era mía.

strings.text: I only moved my lips. My father was looking straight at us.
strings.translation: Solo movía los labios. Mi padre nos miraba fijamente.

strings.text: I did not sing. My father was looking straight at us.
strings.translation: No canté. Mi padre nos miraba fijamente.

strings.text: By morning all that was left of the field was a grey strip.
strings.translation: Por la mañana, del campo solo quedaba una franja gris.

strings.text: Stay by it
Go with Mother
Don’t look over there, David. Come along.
I did not look back.
When my father was reading, you were not to stir.
strings.translation: Cuando mi padre leía, no había que moverse.

strings.text: I took hold of the edge of the table and kept still.
strings.translation: Me agarré al borde de la mesa y me quedé quieto.

strings.text: “And each leg shall have two joints and one foot, and each foot five toes…”
strings.translation: —«Y cada pierna tendrá dos articulaciones y un pie, y cada pie cinco dedos…»

strings.text: …and whatever is not so formed is a Blasphemy against the true Image, and hateful in the sight of God.
strings.translation: —…y todo lo que no esté así formado es una Blasfemia contra la verdadera Imagen, y odioso a los ojos de Dios.

strings.text: A rider saw the Wender girl by the stream. Barefoot.
strings.translation: —Un jinete vio a la niña de los Wender junto al arroyo. Descalza.

strings.text: The Wenders have a daughter with a Deviation. They’ll be fetched in the morning.
strings.translation: —Los Wender tienen una hija con una Desviación. Irán a buscarlos por la mañana.

strings.text: David? What’s wrong with you? You’re as tight as a string.
strings.translation: ¿David? ¿Qué te pasa? Estás tenso como una cuerda.

strings.text: Sit still while the Word is read.
strings.translation: —Quédate quieto mientras se lee la Palabra.

strings.text: My mother did not raise her eyes. She knew whom he meant.
strings.translation: Mi madre no alzó los ojos. Sabía de quién hablaba.

strings.text: I looked at the table and counted my heartbeats.
strings.translation: Miraba la mesa y contaba los latidos de mi corazón.

strings.text: Warn the Wenders
Stay in bed
I lay down without undressing.
I waited until the house was still.
strings.translation: Esperé a que la casa quedara en silencio.

strings.text: They’ll come for you in the morning.
strings.translation: —Vendrán a por vosotros por la mañana.

strings.text: Mummy knows. We’re going to the Fringes.
strings.translation: —Mamá lo sabe. Nos vamos a las Tierras Marginales.

strings.text: Thank you, David.
In the morning the Wenders’ house stood empty.
strings.translation: Por la mañana, la casa de los Wender estaba vacía.

strings.text: I lay and listened to the rain.
strings.translation: Me quedé acostado escuchando la lluvia.

strings.text: Sophie will think you knew.
They were caught at the very edge of the Fringes. They said Sophie broke free and ran into the forest.
strings.translation: Los atraparon justo al borde de las Tierras Marginales. Decían que Sophie se soltó y huyó al bosque.

strings.text: Voices
Uncle Axel asked
point to the window
shake my head
A strange voice
answer her
Rosalind on the square
look at her
not look
Anne leaves
let her go
tell Axel
Uncle Axel had been a sailor once. Then he hurt his leg and became my father’s smith.
strings.translation: El tío Axel había sido marinero. Luego se lastimó la pierna y se hizo herrero de mi padre.

strings.text: I liked to sit on a barrel in his forge. And to chatter — with someone no one but me could hear.
strings.translation: Me gustaba sentarme en un barril en su herrería. Y charlar con alguien a quien nadie más que yo podía oír.

strings.text: David? Are you at the forge again?
Yes. Uncle’s making horseshoes. It’s warm here.
strings.translation: Sí. El tío está haciendo herraduras. Aquí se está calentito.

strings.text: Our cow got loose. The whole house was out catching her.
strings.translation: Se nos ha soltado la vaca. Toda la casa ha salido a atraparla.

strings.text: I laughed out loud. My uncle’s hammer stopped.
strings.translation: Me reí en voz alta. El martillo de mi tío se detuvo.

strings.text: Who are you talking to, Davie?
Show the window
Shake my head
Beyond the field the Mortons’ window was lit. That was where Rosalind lived.
strings.translation: Al otro lado del campo brillaba la ventana de los Morton. Allí vivía Rosalind.

strings.text: Right across the field? Without words?
strings.translation: —¿A través de todo el campo? ¿Sin palabras?

strings.text: No one, eh? And yet you look — over there.
strings.translation: —Con nadie, ¿eh? Y sin embargo miras hacia allí.

strings.text: No one, do you hear? Not your father, not your mother. Not a living soul.
strings.translation: —A nadie, ¿me oyes? Ni a tu padre, ni a tu madre. A ningún alma viviente.

strings.text: And tell the others the same.
strings.translation: —Y diles lo mismo a los otros.

strings.text: Your father. To the bellows, Davie. Quick.
The farmhand had told him about the calf. My father was looking not at my uncle — at me.
strings.translation: El mozo le había contado lo del ternero. Mi padre no miraba a mi tío, sino a mí.

strings.text: My bellows wheezed out of time. My father raised his lantern and looked at me for a long while.
strings.translation: Mi fuelle resollaba a destiempo. Mi padre alzó el farol y me miró largo rato.

strings.text: My father stood a while, nodded to my uncle and went away.
strings.translation: Mi padre se quedó un rato, saludó a mi tío con la cabeza y se fue.

strings.text: My uncle said nothing. He only nodded to me across the forge.
strings.translation: Mi tío no dijo nada. Solo me hizo un gesto con la cabeza desde el otro lado de la herrería.

strings.text: In the evenings my uncle told me what he had seen over the sea.
strings.translation: Por las tardes mi tío me contaba lo que había visto al otro lado del mar.

strings.text: The sea?
The Old People?
The people there?
What is it like, the sea?
Have you seen where the Old People lived?
And what are the people like there?
strings.translation: —¿Y cómo es la gente de allí?

strings.text: Bigger than all our land. You sail for weeks — and not a shore in sight.
strings.translation: —Más grande que toda nuestra tierra. Navegas semanas enteras, y ni una costa a la vista.

strings.text: I have. Black glass for miles and miles. Nothing grows there to this day.
strings.translation: —Lo he visto. Vidrio negro durante millas y millas. Allí todavía no crece nada.

strings.text: All sorts. In the south there’s a coast where everyone has six toes. And they think we’re the deviants.
strings.translation: —De todo tipo. En el sur hay una costa donde todos tienen seis dedos en los pies. Y los desviados, para ellos, somos nosotros.

strings.text: Our ship was a tall one, three masts. Sails one above the other.
strings.translation: —Nuestro barco era alto, de tres palos. Velas una encima de otra.

strings.text: And over the glass — towers. Taller than our church tower, and every one of them broken.
strings.translation: —Y sobre el vidrio, torres. Más altas que nuestro campanario, y todas rotas.

strings.text: Their coast is green. The trees are thin and tall, and their tops are like umbrellas.
strings.translation: —Su costa es verde. Los árboles son finos y altos, y sus copas parecen paraguas.

strings.text: I showed him the plate from the ruins.
strings.translation: Le enseñé la placa de las ruinas.

strings.text: Hide it. And don’t show it to your father.
strings.translation: —Escóndela. Y no se la enseñes a tu padre.

strings.text: I thought of Sophie.
The true image, you say? And who has ever seen it, this image?
strings.translation: —¿La verdadera imagen, dices? ¿Y quién la ha visto nunca, esa imagen?

strings.text: Labrador isn’t the whole world, Davie.
strings.translation: —Labrador no es el mundo entero, Davie.

strings.text: The years went by. We found one another — those who could hear.
strings.translation: Pasaron los años. Nos encontramos unos a otros, los que podíamos oír.

strings.text: By day, at work, we learnt to know one another right across the valley.
strings.translation: De día, trabajando, aprendíamos a reconocernos de un extremo a otro del valle.

strings.text: Half the day at the washing line again. Is anybody there?
strings.translation: Otra vez media jornada tendiendo la ropa. ¿Hay alguien ahí?

strings.text: Anne.
Anne. She found me herself.
strings.translation: Anne. Ella me encontró a mí.

strings.text: The sheep are scattered all over the hill. David, where are you?
strings.translation: Las ovejas se han desperdigado por toda la colina. David, ¿dónde estás?

strings.text: The ploughman looked at me a long time from under his hand. And I stood and looked at the sky.
strings.translation: El labrador me miró largo rato haciéndose visera con la mano. Y yo me quedé mirando el cielo.

strings.text: I went back to my hoeing. The ploughman stood a while and started his horse.
strings.translation: Volví a mi azada. El labrador se quedó un rato y arreó al caballo.

strings.text: Michael. Then Mark answered — from a cart on the road.
strings.translation: Michael. Luego respondió Mark, desde un carro en el camino.

strings.text: Who’s there? Who is it talking?
Don’t answer. We don’t know her.
She’s all alone out there. As we were once.
strings.translation: Está ahí completamente sola. Como nosotros antes.

strings.text: Answer her
Keep quiet
I thought I was the only one.
Now there are nine of us. And nine of us who might let it slip.
strings.translation: Ahora somos nueve. Y nueve que pueden irse de la lengua.

strings.text: Who’s there…?
She called for a few more evenings. Then she stopped.
strings.translation: Llamó unas cuantas tardes más. Luego dejó de hacerlo.

strings.text: We were sixteen. In front of everyone, Rosalind and I were almost strangers.
strings.translation: Teníamos dieciséis años. Delante de todos, Rosalind y yo éramos casi unos extraños.

strings.text: That day the old woman by the well never took her eyes off me.
strings.translation: Aquel día la vieja junto al pozo no me quitó los ojos de encima.

strings.text: My eyes went looking for her by themselves. I kept taking them away — to the well, to the church, anywhere.
strings.translation: Mis ojos la buscaban solos. Yo los apartaba: al pozo, a la iglesia, a cualquier parte.

strings.text: Don’t look at me. Just listen.
Some day we’ll go away from here. The two of us.
strings.translation: Algún día nos iremos de aquí. Los dos.

strings.text: Where to? It’s the Fringes all round.
Uncle says the world is bigger than Labrador.
strings.translation: El tío dice que el mundo es más grande que Labrador.

strings.text: Then — there.
I’m smiling now. A pity you can’t see.
strings.translation: Ahora estoy sonriendo. Lástima que no puedas verlo.

strings.text: Don’t. They’re looking at us.
The old woman with the stick watched us until we parted.
strings.translation: La vieja del bastón nos observó hasta que nos separamos.

strings.text: Rosalind will remember this.
I never did turn round. She went off with her parents without looking back.
strings.translation: No llegué a volverme. Ella se fue con sus padres sin mirar atrás.

strings.text: Some day I want you to look at me. In front of everyone.
strings.translation: Algún día quiero que me mires. Delante de todos.

strings.text: At night I went up the hill and called them. One after another.
strings.translation: Por las noches subía a la colina y los llamaba. Uno tras otro.

strings.text: I’m here.
Here. Why so late?
And me.
Suddenly an answer came from our own house — so thin and so loud my ears rang. And at once it was gone.
strings.translation: De pronto alguien respondió desde nuestra propia casa, tan agudo y tan fuerte que me zumbaron los oídos. Y enseguida se apagó.

strings.text: Then Sally and Katherine. Mark. Rachel.
strings.translation: Luego Sally y Katherine. Mark. Rachel.

strings.text: Don’t call me any more. I’m marrying Alan Ervin.
strings.translation: No me llaméis más. Me caso con Alan Ervin.

strings.text: I want to live like everyone else. Do you hear? Like everyone else.
strings.translation: Quiero vivir como todo el mundo. ¿Me oís? Como todo el mundo.

strings.text: She’ll tell him. Not at once — but in a year.
strings.translation: Se lo dirá. No enseguida, pero sí dentro de un año.

strings.text: She’s one of us. You can’t hold her by force.
strings.translation: Es una de nosotros. No se la puede retener por la fuerza.

strings.text: Let her go
Tell Axel
Then we’ll pray she keeps quiet.
Anne will remember this.
I told my uncle about Anne and Alan.
strings.translation: Le conté a mi tío lo de Anne y Alan.

strings.text: All right. Off to bed, Davie.
A week later Alan was found by the road. With an arrow in his throat.
strings.translation: Una semana después encontraron a Alan junto al camino. Con una flecha en la garganta.

strings.text: My uncle asked me nothing. Nor I him.
strings.translation: Mi tío no me preguntó nada. Ni yo a él.

strings.text: It was you. I know it was you.
strings.translation: Fuisteis vosotros. Sé que fuisteis vosotros.

strings.text: Anne answered no more.
And at home, in the little room, my sister Petra was asleep.
strings.translation: Y en casa, en el cuarto pequeño, dormía mi hermana Petra.

strings.text: I did not know yet who had answered me from our house.
strings.translation: Aún no sabía quién me había respondido desde nuestra casa.

strings.text: Petra
The cry at the river
she went quiet
she cried to the end
Petra’s gift
teach her to hide her thoughts
let her be herself
The voice from over the sea
strings.translation: La voz del otro lado del mar

strings.text: answer
only listen
In spring, when Petra was six, she went off to the river alone.
strings.translation: En primavera, cuando Petra tenía seis años, se fue sola al río.

strings.text: And then it struck into my head. Not a voice — fear, enormous, without words.
strings.translation: Y entonces me golpeó en la cabeza. No una voz: miedo, enorme, sin palabras.

strings.text: David…!
Petra, I’m here. Breathe with me.
She went quiet. No one farther than Rosalind heard her.
strings.translation: Se calmó. Nadie más lejos que Rosalind la oyó.

strings.text: The grown-ups heard not a sound. They saw her run.
strings.translation: Los mayores no oyeron ni un sonido. La vieron correr.

strings.text: I brought her out onto the bank. She was crying — out loud, like any child.
strings.translation: La saqué a la orilla. Lloraba en voz alta, como cualquier niña.

strings.text: I brought her out onto the bank. She called to the very last — and not with her mouth.
strings.translation: La saqué a la orilla. Llamó hasta el último momento, y no con la boca.

strings.text: Is that her? Your sister?
I held on. But the branch broke.
strings.translation: —Me agarraba. Pero la rama se rompió.

strings.text: All of ours heard her. And they saw us running.
strings.translation: La oyeron todos los nuestros. Y ellos nos vieron correr.

strings.text: She went quiet all of a sudden. Was it you who calmed her?
strings.translation: Se calmó de repente. ¿Fuiste tú quien la tranquilizó?

strings.text: She’s stronger than all of us, David. What are we going to do with her?
strings.translation: Es más fuerte que todos nosotros, David. ¿Qué vamos a hacer con ella?

strings.text: Carry Petra home
From that day Petra was among us. Her thoughts thundered all over the district.
strings.translation: Desde aquel día Petra estuvo entre nosotros. Sus pensamientos retumbaban por toda la comarca.

strings.text: Here. Quietly, David. She’s listening.
strings.translation: Aquí. Más bajo, David. Está escuchando.

strings.text: David, is that you? I want to be with you too!
strings.translation: David, ¿eres tú? ¡Yo también quiero estar con vosotros!

strings.text: She shouted us all down. Alone.
strings.translation: Nos tapó a todos con su voz. Ella sola.

strings.text: Anne has guessed already. Teach Petra to hide her thoughts, David.
strings.translation: Anne ya lo sospecha. Enseña a Petra a esconder sus pensamientos, David.

strings.text: Teach her to hide her thoughts. Or the wrong people will hear her.
strings.translation: Enséñale a esconder sus pensamientos. Si no, la oirá quien no debe.

strings.text: We hide all our lives. Let her at least be as she is.
strings.translation: Nos escondemos toda la vida. Que al menos ella sea como es.

strings.text: Hide her thoughts
Let her call
My father taught me to spot Deviations. Now I was teaching my sister to hide them.
strings.translation: Mi padre me enseñó a descubrir Desviaciones. Ahora yo enseñaba a mi hermana a esconderlas.

strings.text: Every evening I taught her: think quietly, very quietly, as if you were whispering.
strings.translation: Cada tarde le enseñaba: piensa bajito, muy bajito, como si susurraras.

strings.text: All right. I’ll be tiny, tiny.
Petra will remember this.
David! I can hear all of you! All of you!
strings.translation: ¡David! ¡Os oigo a todos! ¡A todos, a todos!

strings.text: She’ll give us away, David.
Once already I had told myself to keep quiet. I did not want to again.
strings.translation: Una vez ya me había ordenado callar. No quería volver a hacerlo.

strings.text: I dreamt of that city again. I followed a shining fish with my eyes — quietly, quietly, so as not to wake.
strings.translation: Volví a soñar con aquella ciudad. Seguía con la mirada un pez brillante, despacio, despacio, para no despertarme.

strings.text: The dream fell apart. I never made out the towers.
strings.translation: El sueño se deshizo. Nunca llegué a distinguir las torres.

strings.text: I had time to make out every tower.
strings.translation: Tuve tiempo de distinguir cada torre.

strings.text: A month later Petra woke me in the middle of the night.
strings.translation: Un mes después Petra me despertó en mitad de la noche.

strings.text: David, somebody’s talking out there. Far, far away, over the water.
strings.translation: —David, alguien está hablando allá. Muy, muy lejos, al otro lado del agua.

strings.text: She showed me what she saw. And I knew the city from my dream.
strings.translation: Me mostró lo que veía. Y reconocí la ciudad de mi sueño.

strings.text: Who are you, little girl? Where are you? You call so loudly.
strings.translation: ¿Quién eres, pequeña? ¿Dónde estás? Llamas tan fuerte…

strings.text: …who are you… where…
I can’t hear words. Only that somebody’s there.
strings.translation: —No oigo las palabras. Solo que allí hay alguien.

strings.text: Answer her, Petra
Don’t answer
Answer her, Petra.
Don’t answer. We don’t know who it is.
I’m Petra! I’m here!
I hear you. Call to me again.
David, what is it? Someone strange can hear us.
strings.translation: David, ¿qué es esto? Alguien extraño nos oye.

strings.text: Petra did as she was told. The voice called a while longer, fainter and fainter, and then it was gone.
strings.translation: Petra obedeció. La voz siguió llamando un rato, cada vez más débil, y luego desapareció.

strings.text: That city was real. Somewhere over the sea.
strings.translation: Aquella ciudad existía de verdad. En algún lugar al otro lado del mar.

strings.text: I never did know whether it was a dream.
strings.translation: Nunca supe si había sido un sueño.

strings.text: Discovery
When Katherine and Sally were taken
strings.translation: Cuando se llevaron a Katherine y a Sally

strings.text: run now
get them out
The man with the lantern
keep the bellows’ rhythm
give my uncle the nod
got away
caught
Questioning
deny it
tell the truth
The trial
my own got me out
blew out the lamp
knocked over the lamp
Sheba
let her go home
take her along
The rider on the crest
shoot him
over his head
freeze in the fog
By the shadows
went in the shadows
the lantern saw us
That evening my father read longer than usual.
strings.translation: Aquella tarde mi padre leyó más que de costumbre.

strings.text: Anne is dead. She left a letter for the inspector. All our names are in it.
strings.translation: Anne ha muerto. Dejó una carta para el inspector. Ahí están todos nuestros nombres.

strings.text: Anne told Alan everything. In the morning Alan was at the inspector’s.
strings.translation: Anne se lo contó todo a Alan. Por la mañana Alan estaba en casa del inspector.

strings.text: We’ve been given away.
They’ve taken Katherine and Sally. They’re being questioned.
strings.translation: Se han llevado a Katherine y a Sally. Las están interrogando.

strings.text: David… They’re asking about you. I won’t tell. I’ll try.
strings.translation: David… Preguntan por ti. No lo diré. Lo intentaré.

strings.text: David. What are you thinking about while I read?
He’s tired, Joseph. Let him go to bed.
strings.translation: —Está cansado, Joseph. Deja que se vaya a dormir.

strings.text: Go tonight. With Petra. Rosalind will wait at the ford.
strings.translation: Vete esta noche. Con Petra. Rosalind te esperará en el vado.

strings.text: Go with Petra
Free the girls
Then I’ll wait at the ford. Till dawn — no longer.
strings.translation: Entonces esperaré en el vado. Hasta el alba, no más.

strings.text: Katherine and Sally will remember this.
In the night I woke Petra and carried her out of the house.
strings.translation: De noche desperté a Petra y la saqué de casa en brazos.

strings.text: David, where are we going?
Far away. Only think quietly.
I can’t do quietly!
Look back
Don’t look back
My mother stood at the window. She watched us go, and she did not call my father.
strings.translation: Mi madre estaba en la ventana. Nos vio marchar, y no llamó a mi padre.

strings.text: The window went dark. No one in the house woke.
strings.translation: La ventana se apagó. En la casa nadie se despertó.

strings.text: Riders were waiting at the gate. The inspector knew whom to come for.
strings.translation: En la puerta esperaban unos jinetes. El inspector sabía a por quién venir.

strings.text: Petra, run to the ford. To Rosalind.
strings.translation: Petra, corre al vado. Con Rosalind.

strings.text: Petra slipped out of my arms and vanished into the dark. No one went after her.
strings.translation: Petra se me escurrió de los brazos y desapareció en la oscuridad. Nadie fue tras ella.

strings.text: I hear her. I’m coming to meet her.
strings.translation: La oigo. Voy a su encuentro.

strings.text: I ran to Uncle Axel. There was no one else to go to.
strings.translation: Corrí a casa del tío Axel. No tenía a nadie más.

strings.text: They’re holding them at the inspector’s, in the cellar. The door’s locked.
strings.translation: —Las tienen en casa del inspector, en el sótano. La puerta está cerrada con llave.

strings.text: I’ll make a key. And you work the bellows — let them think I’m working.
strings.translation: —Yo haré una llave. Y tú dale al fuelle, que crean que estoy trabajando.

strings.text: A man with a lantern stopped in the gateway.
strings.translation: Un hombre con un farol se detuvo en la entrada.

strings.text: My father’s farmhand. The one who saw the calf.
strings.translation: El mozo de mi padre. El que vio el ternero.

strings.text: Work the bellows
Nod to strike
He looked me in the face — and whistled. Two more came up out of the dark.
strings.translation: Me miró a la cara y silbó. De la oscuridad salieron dos más.

strings.text: My uncle stood there with his hammer. I shook my head: don’t.
strings.translation: Mi tío seguía allí con el martillo. Negué con la cabeza: no.

strings.text: He stood a while and went away. He did not notice. Or did not want to.
strings.translation: Se quedó un rato y se fue. No se dio cuenta. O no quiso darse cuenta.

strings.text: My uncle stepped towards the gate. The man had no time to turn round.
strings.translation: Mi tío dio un paso hacia la entrada. El hombre no tuvo tiempo de volverse.

strings.text: We dragged him into the dark. He was breathing.
strings.translation: Lo arrastramos a la oscuridad. Respiraba.

strings.text: Towards morning my uncle came back alone.
strings.translation: De madrugada mi tío volvió solo.

strings.text: They’re away. Another road, to the Fringes. Now it’s your turn, Davie.
strings.translation: —Se han ido. Por otro camino, hacia las Tierras Marginales. Ahora te toca a ti, Davie.

strings.text: They brought me to the meeting-house. It was night; one lamp burned on the elders’ table.
strings.translation: Me llevaron a la casa de reuniones. Era de noche; sobre la mesa de los ancianos ardía una sola lámpara.

strings.text: The men came in one by one and sat down along the walls. My father stood apart.
strings.translation: Los hombres entraban uno a uno y se sentaban junto a las paredes. Mi padre estaba aparte.

strings.text: The girls named you, David. Do you hear them without words?
strings.translation: —Las chicas te han nombrado, David. ¿Las oyes sin palabras?

strings.text: I don’t understand
Keep silent
I hear them
I don’t understand what you mean.
I do. And there is no sin in it.
strings.translation: —Las oigo. Y no hay pecado en ello.

strings.text: They didn’t understand at first either.
Answer when you are asked.
Then you are no son of mine.
In the morning they’ll take you away. They’ll ask you differently there.
strings.translation: —Por la mañana te llevarán. Allí te preguntarán de otra manera.

strings.text: David. We’re close. Now.
Someone shouted in the yard: the barn was on fire.
strings.translation: Alguien gritó en el patio: el granero estaba ardiendo.

strings.text: Everyone rushed for the doors — the inspector, my father, the men.
strings.translation: Todos corrieron hacia las puertas: el inspector, mi padre, los hombres.

strings.text: Petra’s with us — we got her out through the window. Run to the ford.
strings.translation: Petra está con nosotros; la sacamos por la ventana. Corre al vado.

strings.text: Petra’s with me. Run to the ford.
strings.translation: Petra está conmigo. Corre al vado.

strings.text: Run
There are too few of us, David. Get yourself out.
strings.translation: Somos demasiado pocos, David. Sal tú solo.

strings.text: Blow it out
Knock it over
In the dark my father caught me by the sleeve. I tore free.
strings.translation: En la oscuridad mi padre me agarró de la manga. Me solté.

strings.text: He shouted after me until I reached the gate.
strings.translation: Me gritó hasta que llegué a la puerta.

strings.text: The oil flared up across the floor. Everyone rushed to put it out, and I made for the window.
strings.translation: El aceite prendió por el suelo. Todos corrieron a apagarlo, y yo fui hacia la ventana.

strings.text: I carried Petra out through the window of her room.
strings.translation: Saqué a Petra por la ventana de su cuarto.

strings.text: I took Sheba from the paddock behind the house. Petra was already waiting for me — in a pannier on Rosalind’s horse.
strings.translation: Saqué a Sheba del cercado de detrás de la casa. Petra ya me esperaba, en una alforja del caballo de Rosalind.

strings.text: David! I knew you’d come!
Rosalind was waiting beyond the ford, on the ridge, with her father’s two great-horses.
strings.translation: Rosalind esperaba al otro lado del vado, en la cresta, con los dos grandes caballos de su padre.

strings.text: I’m staying. I’ll be among them — and I’ll listen.
strings.translation: Yo me quedo. Estaré entre ellos, y escucharé.

strings.text: Let her go, David. She’s no match for the great-horses. And she neighs fit to wake the whole district.
strings.translation: Déjala ir, David. No puede seguir a los grandes caballos. Y relincha tan fuerte que despertaría a toda la comarca.

strings.text: Let Sheba go
Take Sheba
Sheba went home alone. There was no way back.
strings.translation: Sheba se fue sola a casa. No había camino de vuelta.

strings.text: I couldn’t. I led her back and tied her rein to the pack-horse.
strings.translation: No pude. La traje de vuelta y até su rienda al caballo de carga.

strings.text: Lanterns on the road. Your father is with them.
strings.translation: Faroles en el camino. Tu padre va con ellos.

strings.text: They found that man at the forge. The whole district has turned out after you.
strings.translation: Han encontrado a aquel hombre junto a la herrería. Toda la comarca ha salido tras vosotros.

strings.text: Beyond the shoulder of the ridge the road dipped into a hollow. The hollow was full of fog.
strings.translation: Pasado el lomo de la cresta, el camino bajaba a una hondonada. La hondonada estaba llena de niebla.

strings.text: We stand still. Let them go by.
Two riders with lanterns came up onto the crest.
strings.translation: Dos jinetes con faroles subieron a la cresta.

strings.text: The first one raised his lantern higher — and saw us. The second galloped back for the others.
strings.translation: El primero alzó el farol y nos vio. El segundo volvió al galope a por los demás.

strings.text: He’s coming this way.
They shone their lanterns into the fog for a long time. Then the second turned back for the others, and the first stayed to watch the road.
strings.translation: Estuvieron mucho rato alumbrando la niebla con los faroles. Luego el segundo volvió a por los demás, y el primero se quedó vigilando el camino.

strings.text: It’ll be dawn soon. The fog will lift — and he’ll see us.
strings.translation: Pronto amanecerá. La niebla se levantará, y nos verá.

strings.text: Shoot him
Over his head
Freeze
Shoot him.
Shoot over his head!
I had no time to say anything. Rosalind had already drawn her bow.
strings.translation: No tuve tiempo de decir nada. Rosalind ya había tensado el arco.

strings.text: The rider fell. His horse went off over the crest alone.
strings.translation: El jinete cayó. Su caballo se fue solo al otro lado de la cresta.

strings.text: He wouldn’t have spared us, David.
strings.translation: Él no nos habría perdonado, David.

strings.text: He never saw us at all.
The arrow whistled just over his head. The horse shied, and the rider galloped off over the crest.
strings.translation: La flecha silbó justo por encima de su cabeza. El caballo se espantó, y el jinete se alejó al galope tras la cresta.

strings.text: He saw where we went.
Now he knows where we are.
We froze. Petra clapped her little hand over her mouth.
strings.translation: Nos quedamos inmóviles. Petra se tapó la boca con la manita.

strings.text: He rode right up to the edge of the hollow and shone his lantern into the fog for a long time.
strings.translation: Se acercó hasta el mismo borde de la hondonada y estuvo mucho rato alumbrando la niebla.

strings.text: He rode along the edge of the hollow, shining his lantern into the fog. Very close.
strings.translation: Cabalgó por el borde de la hondonada, alumbrando la niebla. Muy cerca.

strings.text: He saw us. He won’t come back alone.
strings.translation: Nos ha visto. No volverá solo.

strings.text: We’ve lost an hour. Now they’ll reach the Fringes before us.
strings.translation: Hemos perdido una hora. Ahora llegarán a las Tierras Marginales antes que nosotros.

strings.text: By dawn the lanterns had fallen behind. By day we hid in the woods.
strings.translation: Al alba los faroles se habían quedado atrás. De día nos escondíamos en el bosque.

strings.text: They’ve taken Katherine and Sally away. I could do nothing.
strings.translation: Se han llevado a Katherine y a Sally. No he podido hacer nada.

strings.text: That rider died. There’ll be no mercy now — not for you, not for them.
strings.translation: Aquel jinete ha muerto. Ahora no habrá piedad: ni para vosotros, ni para ellas.

strings.text: We hear you. Hold on. We are coming.
strings.translation: Os oímos. Aguantad. Vamos hacia allí.

strings.text: David, that lady over the water is calling again. She’s looking for us.
strings.translation: —David, aquella señora del otro lado del agua está llamando otra vez. Nos está buscando.

strings.text: On the second night we came out to the last field. Beyond the fence the Fringes began.
strings.translation: La segunda noche llegamos al último campo. Más allá de la cerca empezaban las Tierras Marginales.

strings.text: The lantern was carried by a tall man. I knew my father by his walk.
strings.translation: El farol lo llevaba un hombre alto. Reconocí a mi padre por su forma de andar.

strings.text: The moon stood behind the woods, and the shadows of the trees lay across the field. We could walk along them — or while he shone his light the other way.
strings.translation: La luna estaba detrás del bosque, y las sombras de los árboles cruzaban el campo. Podíamos avanzar por ellas, o mientras él alumbraba hacia otro lado.

strings.text: There they are! By the fence!
There they are! In the field!
Behind us there was shouting, lanterns running to the fence. But no one stepped over it.
strings.translation: Detrás gritaban, los faroles corrían hacia la cerca. Pero nadie la cruzó.

strings.text: The lantern stood a while by the fence and turned back.
strings.translation: El farol se quedó un rato junto a la cerca y dio la vuelta.

strings.text: That’s it, David. We’re in the Fringes.
strings.translation: Ya está, David. Estamos en las Tierras Marginales.

strings.text: The deviant forest closed behind us.
strings.translation: El bosque desviado se cerró tras nosotros.

strings.text: The Fringes
Sophie by the hut
go up to her
wait by the fire
Sophie
hid us
told whose son I am
The Spider-man
stand with the Fringes
strings.translation: ponerme del lado de los Marginales

strings.text: go to the cave
We were brought to the fire. The people round it were not like us. And not like the people in Waknuk.
strings.translation: Nos llevaron junto al fuego. La gente que lo rodeaba no era como nosotros. Ni como la gente de Waknuk.

strings.text: They knew already that we had been followed right to the fence.
strings.translation: Ya sabían que nos habían seguido hasta la misma cerca.

strings.text: By the farthest hut stood a girl in a faded headscarf. Barefoot.
strings.translation: Junto a la última choza había una muchacha con un pañuelo descolorido. Descalza.

strings.text: Do you know her?
Go to Sophie
Wait here
I went up to her. She did not step back.
strings.translation: Me acerqué a ella. No retrocedió.

strings.text: I stayed by the fire. She watched me across the whole camp.
strings.translation: Me quedé junto al fuego. Ella me miraba desde el otro extremo del campamento.

strings.text: David. I remember you.
You came running that night. We got away in time.
strings.translation: —Aquella noche viniste corriendo. Escapamos a tiempo.

strings.text: Come into my hut. Before he’s back.
strings.translation: —Venid a mi choza. Antes de que vuelva él.

strings.text: Sophie hid you.
Until evening she let no one near us.
strings.translation: Hasta la tarde no dejó que nadie se nos acercara.

strings.text: That’s Strorm’s son. Joseph Strorm’s.
strings.translation: —Ese es el hijo de Strorm. De Joseph Strorm.

strings.text: Sophie did not forget.
Rosalind and Petra were tied to a post. I was taken to the one who decided things here.
strings.translation: Ataron a Rosalind y a Petra a un poste. A mí me llevaron ante el que mandaba allí.

strings.text: David, the rope’s prickly!
In the evening a tall man came out to the fire, with long arms like a spider’s.
strings.translation: Por la tarde salió junto al fuego un hombre alto, de brazos largos como los de una araña.

strings.text: He looked me over for a long time. Then he said he was my father’s brother.
strings.translation: Me estuvo examinando mucho rato. Luego dijo que era el hermano de mi padre.

strings.text: We’re here, David, Katherine and I. They leave us alone while they need us.
strings.translation: Estamos aquí, David, Katherine y yo. No nos tocan mientras les seamos útiles.

strings.text: Your father is leading them here. You hear each other without words — you’ll be my eyes.
strings.translation: —Tu padre los está trayendo hacia aquí. Os oís sin palabras: seréis mis ojos.

strings.text: Stand with us — and I’ll let your people go.
strings.translation: —Ponte de nuestro lado, y dejaré ir a los tuyos.

strings.text: He’s just like your father, David. Only from the other side.
strings.translation: Es igual que tu padre, David. Solo que del otro lado.

strings.text: Stand with them
Untie my own
To the cave
He nodded, and the ropes at the post were cut.
strings.translation: Asintió, y cortaron las cuerdas del poste.

strings.text: They put us by the cave above the clearing. From there you could see where they would come from.
strings.translation: Nos pusieron junto a la cueva que dominaba el claro. Desde allí se veía por dónde vendrían.

strings.text: In the night the fire burned low. I crawled to the post and cut the ropes.
strings.translation: De noche el fuego se consumió. Me arrastré hasta el poste y corté las cuerdas.

strings.text: Sophie saw. She turned away to the fire.
strings.translation: Sophie lo vio. Se volvió hacia el fuego.

strings.text: In the night Sophie led us out of the camp by a path even the sentries did not know.
strings.translation: De noche Sophie nos sacó del campamento por un sendero que ni los centinelas conocían.

strings.text: There was nowhere further to run. We hid in the cave above the clearing.
strings.translation: No había adónde seguir huyendo. Nos escondimos en la cueva sobre el claro.

strings.text: At dawn a horn sounded.
They were coming on our tracks — from that same fence.
strings.translation: Venían siguiendo nuestras huellas, desde aquella misma cerca.

strings.text: They were coming through the forest. Many of them. With guns.
strings.translation: Venían a través del bosque. Muchos. Con fusiles.

strings.text: Your father is in front. I can hear him — not in words, I just know.
strings.translation: Tu padre va delante. Lo oigo; no con palabras, simplemente lo sé.

strings.text: David! She’s very close! She says — keep together!
strings.translation: ¡David! ¡Está muy cerca! ¡Dice que no nos separemos!

strings.text: We are almost over you. Don’t scatter. A little longer.
strings.translation: Estamos casi encima de vosotros. No os disperséis. Un poco más.

strings.text: I call her and call her… She hears, but she can’t find us.
strings.translation: La llamo y la llamo… Me oye, pero no nos encuentra.

strings.text: Petra was silent. No one called her from over the sea.
strings.translation: Petra callaba. Nadie la llamaba desde el otro lado del mar.

strings.text: Sophie ran to where the Spider-man had gone.
strings.translation: Sophie corrió hacia donde se había ido el hombre araña.

strings.text: Sealand
The return
Stayed with Michael
Alone
The city of my dream turned out to be real. No one there counted toes.
strings.translation: La ciudad de mi sueño resultó ser real. Allí nadie contaba los dedos de los pies.

strings.text: But even there they spoke of people of the old kind the way my father spoke of Deviations.
strings.translation: Pero incluso allí hablaban de la gente de la vieja especie como mi padre hablaba de las Desviaciones.

strings.text: Eight years later I came back to Waknuk. Unarmed.
strings.translation: Ocho años después volví a Waknuk. Desarmado.

strings.text: Michael was waiting at the ford. They listened to us. Not all of them — but they listened.
strings.translation: Michael me esperaba en el vado. Nos escuchaban. No todos, pero nos escuchaban.

strings.text: The ship went away. We stayed on the ledge — Rosalind, Michael and I.
strings.translation: El barco se fue. Nos quedamos en la cornisa: Rosalind, Michael y yo.

strings.text: What came next was for us to decide now.
strings.translation: Lo que vendría después ahora lo decidíamos nosotros.

strings.text: Rosalind flew away with Petra. I stayed with Michael.
strings.translation: Rosalind se fue volando con Petra. Yo me quedé con Michael.

strings.text: At night I listened to the sky. Sometimes it answered.
strings.translation: Por las noches escuchaba el cielo. A veces respondía.

strings.text: The ship never came. We stayed by the Fringes.
strings.translation: El barco nunca llegó. Nos quedamos junto a las Tierras Marginales.

strings.text: A year later Petra stopped calling. And I stopped waiting.
strings.translation: Un año después Petra dejó de llamar. Y yo dejé de esperar.

We lay behind a rock by the cave. Down below, on the clearing, there was shooting.
strings.translation: Estábamos tumbados tras una roca junto a la cueva. Abajo, en el claro, disparaban.

strings.text: We told the Spider-man where they were coming from. Too late to be sorry now.
strings.translation: Le dijimos al hombre araña por dónde venían. Ya es tarde para arrepentirse.

strings.text: Your father. In front, by the horse.
strings.translation: Tu padre. Delante, junto al caballo.

strings.text: Run to Father
Stay
You can’t, David! You can’t help him!
Sophie was running to the Spider-man.
strings.translation: Sophie corría hacia el hombre araña.

strings.text: David! Stop!
Don’t touch me.
Go, David. Get away from here.
We waited for the ship. The sky stayed empty.
strings.translation: Esperamos el barco. El cielo seguía vacío.

strings.text: The Waknuk men faltered and ran for the forest. They left my father behind.
strings.translation: Los hombres de Waknuk flaquearon y huyeron hacia el bosque. A mi padre lo dejaron atrás.

strings.text: David… She doesn’t answer any more.
It’s her! David, it’s her!
Shield my father
Fall beside him
Cover Petra
Cover Rosalind
Petra lay very still under me. The threads settled on my back.
strings.translation: Petra estaba muy quieta debajo de mí. Los hilos se posaban en mi espalda.

strings.text: Rosalind held Petra. I held them both.
strings.translation: Rosalind sujetaba a Petra. Yo las sujetaba a las dos.

strings.text: I reached no one in time. The threads settled on everyone.
strings.translation: No llegué a tiempo hasta nadie. Los hilos cayeron sobre todos.

strings.text: I lay over my father. The threads settled on me, not on him.
strings.translation: Me tendí sobre mi padre. Los hilos caían sobre mí, no sobre él.

strings.text: I fell beside him. The threads settled on us both.
strings.translation: Caí a su lado. Los hilos nos cubrieron a los dos.

strings.text: They were soft and sticky. And the more you struggled, the tighter they held.
strings.translation: Eran suaves y pegajosos. Y cuanto más te debatías, más apretaban.

strings.text: It grew quiet. The ship came down in the middle of the clearing.
strings.translation: Se hizo el silencio. El barco descendió en medio del claro.

strings.text: It’s you! I know you!
So this is what you are like, Petra. How loudly you call.
strings.translation: Así que así eres, Petra. Qué fuerte llamas.

strings.text: David! Are you alive? I can hardly hear you.
Brave. And foolish.
Under the threads my father was breathing. I saw his fingers stir.
strings.translation: Bajo los hilos mi padre respiraba. Vi cómo se movían sus dedos.

strings.text: This one I will not free. He came to kill you.
strings.translation: A este no lo voy a liberar. Vino a mataros.

strings.text: Don’t pity them. Their time is over.
strings.translation: No te compadezcas de ellos. Su tiempo ha pasado.

strings.text: I’m staying, David. Someone has to tell our kind that we exist.
strings.translation: Yo me quedo, David. Alguien tiene que decirles a los nuestros que existimos.

strings.text: Fly away
Stay with Michael
David, where are you going? Are you coming with us?
Where you go — I go.
I can’t stay, David. Not here. Not after all this.
strings.translation: No puedo quedarme, David. Aquí no. No después de todo esto.

strings.text: Come, David.
On the threshold I looked back. Once.
strings.translation: En el umbral miré atrás. Una vez.

strings.text: I’ll tell them. Some day they’ll begin to listen.
strings.translation: Se lo contaré. Algún día empezarán a escuchar.

A man with a lantern stood in the gateway, watching
strings.translation: En la entrada había un hombre con un farol, mirando

strings.text: The hammer fell steadily, and the fire needed air
strings.translation: El martillo caía con ritmo, y la fragua necesitaba aire

strings.text: Petra was screaming, and only we could hear her
strings.translation: Petra gritaba, y solo nosotros podíamos oírla

strings.text: Under the turf something smooth was shining, not made by us
strings.translation: Bajo el césped brillaba algo liso, que no habíamos hecho nosotros

strings.text: The bell rang out over the valley
strings.translation: La campana resonó sobre el valle

strings.text: A fish swam over the city, and the dream only just held
strings.translation: Un pez nadaba sobre la ciudad, y el sueño apenas se sostenía

strings.text: The inspector went round the yard unhurriedly and would come to the calf any moment
strings.translation: El inspector recorría el patio sin prisa y en cualquier momento llegaría al ternero

strings.text: The rider came closer and closer, and her foot was bare
strings.translation: El jinete se acercaba cada vez más, y ella tenía el pie descalzo

strings.text: The lanterns shone into the fog, and the horses would not stand still
strings.translation: Los faroles alumbraban la niebla, y los caballos no se estaban quietos

strings.text: The hymn went over the field, and my father sang loudest of all
strings.translation: El himno se alzaba sobre el campo, y mi padre era el que más fuerte cantaba

strings.text: She stood across the square, and we were watched
strings.translation: Ella estaba al otro lado de la plaza, y nos miraban

strings.text: The lantern’s light went over the field from the fence to the forest
strings.translation: La luz del farol recorría el campo de la cerca al bosque

strings.text: My father was reading the Definitions, and no one in the kitchen moved
strings.translation: Mi padre leía las Definiciones, y en la cocina nadie se movía

strings.text: Someone in the valley was calling me — without words
strings.translation: Alguien en el valle me llamaba, sin palabras

strings.text: The ploughman was looking our way
The farm lights burned far off again, and Petra was listening
strings.translation: Las luces de las granjas volvían a brillar a lo lejos, y Petra escuchaba

strings.text: At night the farm lights burned far apart
strings.translation: De noche las luces de las granjas brillaban muy lejos unas de otras
